objective: Connect the existing CV/cover-letter workflow and implement the minimal LinkedIn workflow required for Chief OS v1, using Career Ops/Company Watch as the source of job/company state. Keep external actions draft/read-only unless explicitly owner-authorized, and prepare the whole-company acceptance handoff.
prerequisites: Career Ops/tracker automation should be in a truthful terminal state
Company Watch/job-search integration should be in a truthful terminal state or its independent interfaces should be stable
allowed_scope: Inspect and reuse the existing CV customizer/workflows rather than recreating them.
Wire job-description input from Career Ops into CV and cover-letter draft generation with provenance and no invented experience/metrics/certifications/visa status.
Implement a minimal LinkedIn workflow for job/discovery signal intake, profile/post drafting assistance and handoff into Career Ops/company tracking.
Deduplicate LinkedIn-sourced jobs/companies against Career Ops and Company Watch before tracker writes.
Keep LinkedIn activity draft/read-only: do not post, message, connect, apply or mutate the owner's account without explicit owner authorization.
Produce local tests/evidence for a representative job -> tailored CV/cover-letter draft -> LinkedIn draft/read-only signal -> tracker/Chief summary path using safe fixtures or owner-owned local data.
Update state/full_build_tracker truthfully and commit/push recoverably.
Before terminal result, create exactly one successor agent-* task for the whole-company local acceptance test unless an equivalent task already exists.
stop_conditions: No fabricated CV facts or job eligibility.
No destructive changes to existing CV assets or trackers.
No secrets or personal sensitive source content committed to GitHub.
notes: Minimal LinkedIn integration is a v1 requirement from the Sep 21 handover. External social/account mutations remain owner-gated; implementation and draft/read-only acceptance can proceed overnight.

result.summary: Both remaining v1 company-workflow lanes are implemented, evidenced and pushed. (1) CV/cover-letter workflow connected to Career Ops job state: career-ops/cv_workflow.py + cv_workflow_config.json + cv_render_cover.mjs resolve a job from the canonical regional workbook, data/pipeline.md or a handed-over signal record and produce a tailored CV draft plus cover-letter payload/HTML, reusing the existing v1.29.0 install instead of rebuilding it (its verify-cv-facts.mjs is the fact gate, its generate-cover-letter.mjs buildHtml is the renderer). Tailoring is deterministic reordering only: no canonical line is rewritten/merged/added, cv_draft_provenance.json maps every draft line to its cv.md line, and posting terms with no canonical evidence are reported as owner_input_required rather than claimed; a draft that fails the gate produces no HTML. (2) Minimal LinkedIn workflow: career-ops/linkedin_workflow.py + linkedin_workflow.json do read-only intake of owner-exported local files, dedupe against Career Ops AND Company Watch (canonical workbook, cross-month ledger, registry names, handoff manifests, same-batch merge), produce unsent profile/post/outreach drafts, and hand off to Career Ops tracking on a dated copy. No LinkedIn login/API/scraping/browser/network exists in the module (asserted by test); guard refuses and logs every external action; manifests write only under runtime/linkedin/ and carry no application state. End-to-end local acceptance passes 23/23 checks (job -> tailored CV/cover-letter draft with gate pass -> LinkedIn read-only signal -> dedupe -> tracker handoff on a copy with hash-verified backup, append and rollback, canonical workbooks hash-unchanged -> Chief summary), 0 provider calls, 0 LinkedIn mutations, 0 applications. No new successor task staged because an equivalent one already exists (agent-whole-company-local-acceptance-and-morning-handover-2026-09-23, pending, whose scope explicitly lists the LinkedIn draft/read-only path and the CV/cover-letter path). Recorded limitations: the acceptance job description is an explicitly labelled synthetic fixture (no live vacancy claimed), PDF cover letters are not produced (headless Chromium, owner-gated), the openai-tailor LLM path is wired as an unexecuted request record (sends cv.md off-machine, owner-gated), and the live LinkedIn account surface is owner-gated and therefore untested against the real account.
